spans.s: pl. ruins, rubbish, VS. xxx, 11; TS. &c., often ifc. in names of old villages half or entirely gone to ruin (e.g. गुप्तार्म, कुक्कुटार्म, बृहद्-अर्म, &c., qq.vv.), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 90 seq. and viii, 2, 2, Sch.
n. a potsherd from a heap of rubbish, TS.
n. a measure of one droṇa, Suśr.
a disease of the eyes, Suśr.
